What is the primary role of an authoritative DNS server?

answers.a: To resolve all DNS queries from clients

questions.question: What does the TTL (Time-To-Live) field in a DNS record specify?

answers.a: The time after which the DNS record expires
answers.b: The priority of the DNS query
answers.c: The security level of a DNS response
answers.d: The number of recursive queries allowed

questions.question: Which of the following best describes an iterative DNS query?

answers.a: The server handles the entire query process and returns the final answer
answers.b: The server refers the client to another DNS server instead of resolving it itself
answers.c: The server provides encrypted responses for enhanced security
answers.d: The server caches the results for permanent storage
